name: TextBox 12
text:
Project Title: Stock Market Prediction Dashboard
Subtitle: An Explainable Indian Equity Growth Outlook System
Team Members: [NAME — ROLL NO.]
[ADD MEMBERS]
Supervisor: [NAME, DESIGNATION]

name: TextBox 14
text: This project begins with a working financial-news dashboard using FinBERT to summarize article tone. It proposes testing whether news, company fundamentals, Indian sector context, and search interest can support a 12-month equity growth outlook. Sentiment alone is not a return forecast.

name: TextBox 15
text: Problem: financial news is scattered and sentiment can be confused with future growth. Scope: Indian equities, point-in-time data, a 12-month positive/non-positive adjusted-return target, transparent validation, and cautious interpretation.

name: TextBox 16
text:
CURRENT: Streamlit company search; NewsAPI / Marketaux / Finnhub adapters; article deduplication and relevance ranking; FinBERT positive/neutral/negative tone; charts, comparison, CSV export.

PROPOSED: dated fundamentals + sector growth + Google Trends attention; baseline/model comparison; time-ordered evaluation; explanations and risk/valuation definitions.

name: TextBox 17
text: Working prototype: news retrieval and FinBERT article sentiment. A tested utility constructs 12-month return labels from adjusted prices. No integrated growth classifier, valuation label, or risk score is claimed yet. Next: validate against an untouched later period. Educational research only; not investment advice.

name: TextBox 18
text:
Current prototype: news retrieval and FinBERT tone summary. The 12-month label helper is tested.

Planned evaluation: baseline comparison and chronological holdout. Prior README backtest not reproduced here; no 12-month classifier result is claimed.

name: TextBox 19
text:
Current: working news/sentiment prototype plus tested 12-month label utility.

Next: build and validate a point-in-time Indian-equity outlook. This is academic research, not investment advice.

name: TextBox 20
text:
References:
Araci (2019), FinBERT, arXiv:1908.10063.
Da, Engelberg & Gao (2011), In Search of Attention, Journal of Finance.
Lundberg & Lee (2017), SHAP, NeurIPS.
ProsusAI/finbert model card.
Student project source, reviewed 22 Oct 2026.

name: TextBox 21
text:
1. Universe + dated data
2. News relevance + FinBERT
3. Point-in-time fundamentals, sector and search features
4. 12-month target labels
5. Chronological baseline/model tests
6. Calibrated outlook + feature explanations
